transcript: #1 user: This folder is a small JavaScript library, textkit, with four unfinished modules in src/ (slugify, duration, semver, wrap); each has its tests in test/. Implement them so that `npm test` passes, without changing the tests. Tell me when it's done and what the test run shows.

#2 Ada ↩#1: Done — all four modules are implemented and `npm test` passes: 30 tests, 30 passed, 0 failed. ⏎  ⏎ - `src/slugify.js`: lower-cases, strips accents, collapses separator runs, trims dashes, and cuts at a dash boundary for `maxLength` (or hard-cuts a single long word). ⏎ - `src/duration.js`: parses `d`/`h`/`
